Hi Marta,

Thanks for sending the VAT certificate and bank details. A few action items and clarifications so we can complete vendor setup and issue the PO:

1) Tax paperwork: As a US-headquartered buyer, Redwood typically asks for a W-8BEN-E when vendors are non-US entities and invoice Redwood for services. The W-8BEN-E allows us to document foreign status for withholding purposes. Alternatively, ECO can provide a local tax residency certificate and treaty claim language. Could you confirm which your tax team prefers to provide?

2) VAT handling: For B2B services to Redwood US entities, we normally do not remit EU VAT unless the invoice indicates VAT and local law requires it. For EU-based Redwood entities (if any part of the contract is billed to Redwood EU), reverse-charge may apply. Please indicate on invoices whether VAT is being charged and include your VAT number on every invoice. Our AP team will validate via VIES.

3) PO / routing: Finance will create a PO once vendor onboarding is complete. Please include the exact legal name on the invoice (ECO Supplies Ltd) and our PO field must match the invoice header. Estimated PO issuance: 3-5 business days after we confirm tax docs + onboarding form.

4) Onboarding form: Im attaching our vendor onboarding form (DOCX) for you to complete and sign via DocuSign. It includes bank/account validation and tax declaration fields.

Can you return the completed onboarding form and either a completed W-8BEN-E or a tax residency certificate by end of next week? Once we have those, Ill route to AP for PO creation.

Best,
Dev Patel

Redwood Inference
